key_insight: ToroFit detects and parameterizes data near a wedge sum of tori, turning complex recurrent structure into fitted toroidal models.
engineering_relevance: The framework supports interpolation, denoising, and nonlinear modeling through an optimization problem reducible to efficiently solvable generalized ridge regression.
method: Use persistent cohomology and cup products to identify distinct toroidal components.
Fit each component with low-energy multivariate trigonometric polynomials.
Solve the resulting generalized ridge regression problem using standard techniques.
evidence_signal: Demonstrations span synthetic and real data, including low-frame-rate recurrent video interpolation, quasiperiodic attractor recovery, and parasite and human gene-space cycle parameterization.
watch_item: Applicability depends on data lying near a wedge sum of tori; the abstract does not quantify robustness to noise or departures from this structure.
paper_title: ToroFit: Fitting Wedge Sums of Tori to High-Dimensional Data
